description: This is a PHP class named EmployeeAttachmentController which manages file download requests for employee attachments in the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract controller for handling file responses and interacts with the EmployeeAttachmentService to fetch attachment data based on request attributes.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentController
classes.description: Controller class that handles downloading employee attachment files, retrieving attachment data via service, setting response headers, and returning the file content.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of EmployeeAttachmentService.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the request to retrieve an employee attachment. Validates request attributes, fetches the attachment, sets appropriate response headers, and returns the file content if found; otherwise, returns a bad request response.
